verdict.rationale: Fedora Workstation is a desktop OS, so installing it in place of an existing OS is a fair question. The pack, however, has no material on an installer, bare-metal installation, or wiping/replacing a current OS. The only install-related item describes running Fedora inside VirtualBox, which is not an in-place install, and community remarks about using Fedora on their machines say nothing about the installation process.
